The contractor will ensure the campground is operated safely, efficiently, and to a consistently high standard, in liaison with Buller District Council as the property owner, and in a manner that reflects the Client’s expectations and community values.

⛺ Greet guests, check them into cabins, caravans or campsites

⛺ Order and/or purchase equipment and supplies, including fuel and stationery (within delegations)
